title: Implement Testimonials section variants (testimonials-cards, testimonials-carousel)
description: Implement two Testimonials variants. testimonials-cards shows all testimonials as a grid of cards. testimonials-carousel shows them one at a time with previous/next navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: TestimonialsContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Each testimonial shows quote, author name, optional role, optional star rating
Carousel has working prev/next buttons and shows current testimonial index
Star rating renders correctly (1-5 stars) if present
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Grid of cards `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`. Each card: large quote mark, quote text, author name (bold), role (muted), star rating (if present). Card background `--color-surface`, border `--color-border`.

Client component (`'use client'`). Single testimonial displayed at a time. Prev/next buttons. Dot indicators showing position. Use `useState` for current index. Quote, author, role, stars. Smooth transition between items.
Take Playwright screenshot. Click next/prev on carousel and verify testimonial changes. Verify star ratings render correctly.
